text:
Maria Chen: Quick ask — want to run a supply-sensitivity sim matrix for H100/H200/L40S lead times + preemptible mix. Forecast vs provisioning gap looks ugly if APAC demand spikes. Can we sketch scenarios here and pick inputs?

Jake Patel: +1. I think 4 scenarios to start: baseline, delayed H200 (leadtime +8–12 weeks), APAC pinch (50% extra demand Nov–Dec), and preemptible outage (30% loss). Keep them small/simple.

Sophie Lee: Where do we pull demand curves from? I can share the weekly GPU-hours per product line. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sim-inputs (see tab 'daily_gpu_hours_v2')

Alex Romero: FYI procurement lead times from vendor last quote: H200 ~22–26 weeks, H100 ~12–16 weeks, L40S ~8–12 weeks. Cost per reserved GPU-hour (ballpark): H200=$7.00, H100=$5.20, L40S=$3.10. Preemptible spot-style instances are ~60% cheaper but can't be relied on during cloud-wide events.

Maria Chen: Good context. Proposed simulation inputs:
- horizon: 6 months (week granularity)
- demand shock: +100% peak for 4 weeks in Nov/Dec (scenario APAC pinch)
- reserve commit mix: baseline 60% reserved H200/H100, 40% on-demand/spot L40S
- fallback policies: cross-region routing enabled, auto-burst to spare pools up to 20%
- SLA target: P95 latency retain for critical routes; but for sim we map to needed GPU-hours

Priya Nair: Also add egress/replication constraint for Private customers in APAC — some Private deployments can't burst to public pools. Mark those workloads as non-fungible in the sim.

Jake Patel: Agreed. Also include variant: accelerate L40S purchases as short-lead hedge (buy +20% L40S capacity now). See quick command to run locally:

```
python sims/run.py \
  --scenario delayed-h200 \
  --samples 10000 \
  --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 \
  --reserve-mix H200:0.5,H100:0.3,L40S:0.2 \
  --preemptible-share 0.25 \
  --non-fungible-tags private_apac
```

Sophie Lee: Can we output per-week shortfall (GPU-hours), expected cost delta, and a probability of dropping below our soft-SLA (i.e., >5% request throttling)? Need CSV per scenario.

Alex Romero: For the delayed-H200 scenario please add vendor leadtime jitter (+/- 4 weeks) and a hard constraint that H200 cannot be delivered into APAC region until week 18 of the sim. That captures shipping/regulatory delays we've seen.

infra-bot: Simulation job queued: sims/demand-sensitivity/1867321987-delayed-h200 (owner: Maria Chen). ETA: ~45m.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Can folks ack and assign owners for the three inputs: demand curves (Sophie), procurement lead times & costs (Alex), non-fungible/private flags (Priya). I'll consolidate scenarios and kick off the final runs. Meeting if results look bad: Thu 10am PT? :calendar: 

Jake Patel: Ack — I'll also add a variant that forces cross-region egress cost into the cost model (+$0.10/GB) to see economic tradeoffs.

Sophie Lee: Ack — will export the demand curves by EOD.

Priya Nair: Ack — will flag private workloads and list customers impacted.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — will post outputs/graphs here when done. :pray:
